title: [AUG-65] Add Groq API option for live transcription mode
why_we_need_this: Live transcription currently runs each audio chunk through local whisper-cli.exe on CPU, which takes 3-15 seconds per chunk — too slow for a real-time feel. Groq's Whisper API returns results in ~200-500ms for small chunks (80-160 KB each, well under the 25MB limit). Adding Groq as an opt-in engine for live mode gives near-instant transcription during live calls while keeping local whisper as the default.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Add a Groq API key setting (server-side config or environment variable GROQ_API_KEY)
- [ ] Implement a Groq transcription function that POSTs audio chunks to Groq's /openai/v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint (model: whisper-large-v3, supports language param: en/ru/auto)
- [ ] In the live transcription WebSocket handler (server/src/services/liveTranscription.ts), add a toggle to route chunks to Groq instead of local whisper-cli.exe
- [ ] Expose the toggle in the client UI — user can choose "Local" or "Groq" before starting a live session
- [ ] When Groq is selected but API key is missing or request fails, fall back to local whisper with a warning
- [ ] Respect Groq free-tier rate limits (20 req/min) — if rate-limited, fall back to local whisper for that chunk and resume Groq on next chunk
- [ ] Post-recording full-file transcription remains local whisper only (Groq's 25MB file limit makes it impractical for full recordings)
important_constraints: This is the first third-party API call in the project — the self-hosted-only invariant (architecture, PRD, transcription routes) applies to post-recording transcription and remains unchanged. Live mode Groq is an explicit user opt-in, not a default. The Groq API key must never be hardcoded or committed to the repo.
